plugin.name: Neko Jam Band
plugin.description: You sing, your catgirl accompanies: real-time pitch detection, auto key estimation, I-V-vi-IV arpeggios. Four synth instruments (piano/epiano/music box/ukulele), plus third-harmony on sustained notes.
entry.jam_start.name: Start Jam
entry.jam_start.description: Start listening and accompany the master's singing.
entry.jam_stop.name: Stop Jam
entry.set_instrument.name: Set Instrument
entry.set_instrument.description: Switch instrument: piano / epiano / music_box / ukulele.
entry.set_key.name: Set Key
entry.set_key.description: Set the key manually (e.g. C, Am) or use auto detection.
entry.set_key.param.key: Key like C / G / Am / F#m, or auto
entry.set_key.error.invalid: Cannot parse key, e.g. C, G, Am
entry.set_pattern.name: Set Pattern
entry.jam_status.name: Jam Status
entry.jam_status.description: Get jam status: key, master's current note, bars played.
entry.recent_notes.name: Recent Notes
entry.recent_notes.description: Get the master's recent sung note names.
